title: An encoder for a few instructions
description:
Turn a few x64 instructions into their bytes.

```
mov eax, 42        -> B8 2A 00 00 00
mov rcx, rdx       -> 48 89 D1
add rax, rbx       -> 48 01 D8
ret                -> C3
```
hints: ModRM for register-to-register is `0xC0 | (source << 3) | destination` for these `/r` forms (lesson 7.01).
`mov eax, imm32` puts the register number in the opcode itself: `0xB8 + reg`, then 4 bytes little-endian.
requirements: Support `mov r32, imm32` (`B8+r`), `mov r64, r64` (`48 89 /r`), `add r64, r64` (`48 01 /r`) and `ret`.
Only the eight original registers (rax to rdi).
Check your bytes by decoding them with a disassembler (or Compiler Explorer's output).
stretch: Add `r8` to `r15` with the REX.R and REX.B bits.
